summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi rose through the Nazi-admiring Hindu nationalist RSS, presided over the 2002 anti-Muslim pogrom in Gujarat as chief minister, and as premier from 2014 pushed Hindu dominance and crushed critics.

evidence.note: RSS history begins: 1920s founding, Savarkar's Hitler praise and Hindutva ideology
Indian Legion of the Waffen-SS and Indian fascination with Hitler and Mein Kampf
Hedgewar models the RSS on Italian and German fascist parties
Modi born 1950 in a small Gujarat town, works at his father's tea stall
Works for the RSS as a full-time street propagandist and organizer
Becomes Gujarat chief minister in 2001 after outmaneuvering a party rival
2002 Gujarat riots: months of killings of Muslims while police stand down
Sohrabuddin fake-encounter killing tied to Amit Shah's extortion racket
2014 campaign recasts Modi as an economic manager; BJP wins
BJP online harassment of journalists, disinformation cell, pressure on NDTV
February 2020 Delhi anti-Muslim violence during the Trump visit closes the story

notes: Covered span starts at the RSS founding (secondary subject with a long segment); Modi is alive, so main_span ends null. Host says Modi is not strictly a dictator, so dictator-autocrat was left out of roles. Hindu nationalism treated as fascism-far-right; nazism secondary for the long segment on Indian Nazi admiration and the Indian Legion.
